title: Connecticut Yankee | KEY.co
description_expanded: The allure of Connecticut Yankee extends beyond its prime location. The resort-style pool, nestled within the natural wooded beauty of Magnolia Cottages, provides a serene retreat after a day of exploration. The community's dedication to preserving its natural charm ensures an atmosphere of tranquility and rejuvenation. Every detail of this picturesque haven is designed to create unforgettable family memories. Connecticut Yankee is more than just a vacation rental; it embodies the essence of seaside living, offering an unparalleled escape where the beauty of land and sea converge. Connecticut Yankee, located in Seacrest Beach, Florida, offers an exceptional vacation experience in the heart of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea. This three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach home seamlessly combines the comforts of modern living with the charm of coastal elegance. Guests are treated to the convenience of a golf cart and four bikes, perfect for exploring the scenic surroundings of 30A. With easy beach access at Gulf Lakes, the pristine, sun-kissed shores are just moments away, inviting relaxation and seaside adventures.
